prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Refine ONE existing Ascend Studio mockup to make all decorative imagery subtle atmospheric BACKGROUND LAYERS.
Image 1 is the exact edit target for layout, content, controls, typography and existing functional decoration meanings. Image 2 is color/material reference ONLY: luminous pale cyan/lavender/rose/coral/apricot/mint/butter-yellow gradients and translucent optical material. Target 1672 x 941, same aspect as image 1. Date anchor 2026-10-09; do not add dates.

User's exact art-direction correction: decorations should be a little lighter in the base background, can lie UNDER THE TEXT, take NO LAYOUT SPACE, have softly dissolving edges, and be understated atmosphere rather than prominent illustrations. Keep the left archival repeating planes, middle two-way interaction surfaces and right open canvas sweep as meanings, but change how they are composited.

PRESERVE every existing UI element, its bounding position and size: logo, breadcrumb, all three columns, new-task/automation/capability entries, project group labels and task rows, compact list spacing, conversation heading/buttons, user message right-aligned neutral bubble, AI plain text directly on background with NO avatar or answer bubble, code/evidence canvas objects, toolbar, minimap and zoom controls. Do not move anything to make room for art, do not add a reserved illustration slot, do not add padding or increase any region height. Keep normal text sharp and dark.

BACKGROUND TREATMENT:
- Reduce the previous artwork's visible strength to roughly one quarter. Pale colorful transmission remains visible, with more vivid hues inside the material but low effective opacity on the warm white background. Approximately 6-10% strength under text, up to 12-16% in nearby blank margins. Avoid reverting to gray monochrome.
- Place the artwork entirely behind typography and controls, like a lightly printed optical texture embedded in the page surface. Selected row surfaces and canvas cards remain above it. Text, icons and code retain their original crisp contrast; soften ONLY the artwork.
- Blend the entire outer silhouette gradually into the base surface using broad, smooth 60-110 pixel feathered fade zones. No hard outline, bright rim, clear cutout contour, crisp cast shadow, glowing border, opaque corner object, boxed gradient patch or visible vignette boundary. Keep just a few VERY faint material fold/refraction cues near the interior so the forms remain intentional.
- The page should first read as a calm working interface. Color and imagery should be discovered second. No poster/banner/hero treatment.

LOCATION-SPECIFIC MEANINGS AS ATMOSPHERE:
A. Left projects: six or seven repeated thin planes suggesting archived pages. Let their faint staggered rhythm spread gently behind the lower project list/footer surface, instead of standing as a conspicuous cropped object in a separate bottom corner. The planes dissolve into white at their upper and side edges. Keep all task rows, compact grouping, selected row and footer unchanged. No literal folder icon, labels or operative card outline.
B. Middle conversation: two opposing cyan/lilac and coral/rose translucent gestures softly meeting and answering each other. Embed their very faint light traces beneath the existing conversation background, flowing partly under the heading and nearby conversation text without impacting legibility. Eliminate the prominent isolated header wave. No extra header band or blank space; no actual speech-bubble shapes, arrows, avatars or connection dots.
C. Right canvas: a pale open curved sheet/sweep embedded behind the dot grid and content objects, softly expanding from the outer edge and fading across the blank canvas background. Remove the sharply readable right-edge silhouette. White code/evidence cards, controls and their text remain clean, crisp and untouched.

Keep the thin transparent material, gentle multi-hue pastel gradients and semantic variation, but make all three ornaments ambient, diffuse and integrated with the base color. No new features, nodes, chips, spheres, pearls, jewelry, actual hardware/chart marks, learning center or concept labels. Do not blur text or change content. Output one realistic refined screen only, no collage, device frame or browser chrome.
